M9-T-F11.U: fixed-oracle classification over nine SVG/signature/prefix samples
M9-T-F11.I: real native sampled content, exact revision-checked bytes and source identity
M9-T-F11.A: all nine actual App branches, including XML/comment/case/whitespace, 512-byte edge/after/split, pure text SVG explicit error/source fallback, PNG magic before SVG extension. SVG rendered as image resource.

M9-T-F12.I: 18 actual encoded/corrupt fixtures through native service; independent installed encoders and ffprobe dimension/frame-count oracle
M9-T-F12.A: avif/bmp/gif/ico/jpeg/jpg/png/webp all actually decoded with correct dimensions, every corrupt sample explicit failure+retry, GIF two displayed compositor frames and PNG alpha0/255 verified

M9-T-F13.I: both tif/tiff including forged image/tiff descriptor upper rejection, real native sample reading/copy/application-grant isolation
M9-T-F13.A: four real TIFF suffix samples show explicit unsupported view without image/editor and expose controlled external/copy actions

M9-T-F25.I: all ten unsupported extensions stay unsupported regardless misleading ASCII content; real app discovery, owner/unlisted app rejection, exact controlled native copies
M9-T-F25.A: all ten actual unsupported views and native discovered Open With menus; save-copy entries present. Explicit boundary: no claim that external Office apps decoded the fixtures; they are fallback dispatch tests.

M9-T-T32.done: R/static D18 reviewed; two actual P header states; production panel tests, r16 missing-download red and r17 two header greens. Native save-copy entry now wired for ordinary Notebook/PDF; attachment callback ownership retained; download error no longer destroys Notebook preview.
M9-T-T32.remaining: Actual native save dialog and downloaded byte comparison plus unresolved prototype download result; CUA connection unavailable, user away so defer without repeated unlock requests.

notCounted.M9-T-T34: System clipboard approval remains pending; no clipboard action or bypass this batch.

M9-DEV-063.problem: Ordinary Notebook did not receive onDownload, so approved top download action was absent in actual r16. Download callback errors also replaced the Notebook view.
M9-DEV-063.fix: Reuse native saveFileCopy for ordinary file download, keep attachment host callback optional and separate download error state; four production panel/Notebook tests passed.
M9-DEV-063.boundary: T32 not fully passed until real native save verified.

M9-DEV-064.problem: A forged lower image/tiff hint bypassed the unsupported suffix at the renderer boundary. Code red reproduced.
M9-DEV-064.fix: FileBuffer.content preserves explicit unsupported extension verdict before lower content hint; native/file-buffer/unit and actual TIFF view checks passed.

boundaries: All actual App runs use isolated synthetic local projects and fresh scoped userdata; no model/CLI/task created.

SVG and unsupported format tests inspect actual rendering and native discovery/copy authority. Unsupported format fixtures intentionally include misleading/non-decoder data; no unsupported decoder or every external application internal behavior claimed.
P/R are separate from actual packaged App. T32 remains incomplete; no whole-theme/pixel equivalence claimed.
Original denied clipboard operation was not retried or bypassed. Old r6 pending input, r4 and AIS directory untouched.
